annotation.title_clean: Comment of the Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP) to the Government of Lesotho in response to Second Draft of the Artificial Intelligence Policy and Implementation Plan
annotation.title_en: Comment of the Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP) to the Government of Lesotho in response to Second Draft of the Artificial Intelligence Policy and Implementation Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: CAIDP's comment to Lesotho's Government on the second draft National AI Policy and Implementation Plan. It recommends red lines banning rights-violating AI, adopting UNESCO's RAM and EIA tools, mandatory transparency, explainability and accountability requirements, and strengthened governance capacity. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibit 'unacceptable' AI such as social scoring, emotion recognition, biometric categorization and predictive policing
Adopt UNESCO Readiness Assessment Methodology and Ethical Impact Assessment tools
Replace voluntary principles with mandatory transparency, explainability and accountability requirements
Strengthen capacity of the AI Policy Maker, Regulator and Data and AI Committee
Align the policy with the AU Continental AI Strategy
